messages:
Maya: ok that was the weirdest and best all-hands outro i've ever heard 😂
Jordan: the improv jingle team deserves a standing ovation :clap: :clap:
Aisha: i will now be humming 'serve it fast, serve it right' for the rest of my week 🫰
Ben: can we get the jingle as hold music for support pls?
Nora: +1 to hold music. also who brought the kazoo? sounded like someone heated a kazoo in a microwave :rofl:
Maya: @Jordan you led the harmonies — chef's kiss 👏👏
Jordan: credit to @Aisha for the final high note — nearly shattered the conference room glass 
DevBot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ah/2189001234/jingle.mp3 (audio clip, 12s)
Ben: downloading. will test as ringer tone and report back
Aisha: lyric snippet for posterity:
```
Serve it fast, serve it right,
Redwood inference, day and night!
```
Jordan: we should make a one-slide one-liner at the top of README: "Our latency is low, our jingles are high" :joy:
Nora: poll: who wants a physical sticker that says "Ask me about batching"
Maya: i vote yes — will wear on my laptop with pride :sticker_heart:
Ben: reaction dump: :applause: x23, :tada: x12, :dog: x1 (for the cameo pupper)
Aisha: pupper cameo was the highlight. 10/10 would all-hands again
Maya: also shoutout to ops for keeping streaming smooth — no audio lag = miracle :pray:
Jordan: agreed. smooth stream + improv jingle = perfect storm :sparkles:
Nora: ok back to real life, but i'm keeping that chorus in my head during standup :grimacing:
DevBot: Reminder: all-hands recording + slides are archived in #all-hands for 30 days
Maya: thanks everyone, encore next quarter? :raised_hands:
